result.reason: The clause does not reach either playbook position. It permits an unspecified minimum commitment in an Order Form and does not limit it to the current 12-month term or make it reducible on 30 days’ notice. Termination carve-outs are not equivalent to the required reduction right, and the credit for “unused commitment” is ambiguous and is not a clearly drafted true-up mechanism. The cross-references and credit concept also add complexity beyond what is needed; a simple no-minimum provision, or the stated fallback mechanics, would be more precise.
